headline: Patriots face Raiders at Gillette while C's and B's stay hot
morning_brew: What a Saturday for the Hub, watching the C's dismantle the Sixers and the B's finally look like the team we know they can be. I spent most of the day at the Garden, and let me tell you, the energy in that building was the exact medicine I needed after a rough week. We needed those wins to keep the momentum rolling, and honestly, seeing the guys put up those kinds of numbers against Philadelphia and the Flyers makes me feel a hell of a lot better about where both squads are sitting.

Now all eyes are on Gillette Stadium today as the Patriots prepare to host the Raiders at one o'clock. Losing Mack Hollins to IR is a damn shame, but hearing that Rhamondre Stevenson is good to go is the kind of boost we need to keep the offense moving. We are sitting at two and two, and this is exactly the kind of game where we have to establish the run early and make Las Vegas play our brand of football. I will be watching every snap, and if our defense can show up the way they have in spurts, we have every reason to think we can walk away with a win.

Robert Kraft is honoring the 2001 championship team today, and it is hard not to think about that era as we look at the 2026 squad. We are a long way from the dynasty days, but there is still plenty of football left to be played. I'll be glued to the screen when kickoff hits, hoping for a clean performance and a big day on the ground. Let's hope the team learned something from the legends in the building because we need a signature win today to get our season heading in the right direction.

news_digest.headline: Patriots place veteran WR Mack Hollins on IR with calf injury
news_digest.dans_take: Just another headache for this offense, so someone on the depth chart better get ready to earn their paycheck.

news_digest.headline: Patriots to honor the 2001 Super Bowl team
news_digest.dans_take: Seeing those old faces back at Gillette should fire the boys up, assuming they don't get distracted by the glory days.

trend_watch.trend: Pritchard exploded for twenty-five points on seven-of-twelve shooting while adding seven assists in the win over the Sixers.
trend_watch.dans_take: Pritchard was playing like he had a cheat code, absolutely unconscious from deep all night long.

trend_watch.trend: Minten tallied a goal and two assists as the Bruins cruised past the Flyers on Saturday.
trend_watch.dans_take: That line looked dynamic all afternoon and Minten was the motor under the hood making it run.

trend_watch.trend: Tatum dropped twenty-three points and grabbed five rebounds in only twenty-seven minutes against Philadelphia.
trend_watch.dans_take: He didn't even have to break a sweat, which is my favorite way to watch a rivalry game.
